publication.repo_gradle_support: Local staging and MavenLocal only; no signing or Central upload task exists.
publication.release_gate_previous_limit: Prior0.9 report explicitly states releaseCheck was not rerun; do not reuse that as0.10 release clearance.

existing_operational_signing_reuse.constraint: Use host JDK17; PgpTool uses InputStream.readAllBytes, so it is operational release tooling, not a Java8 shipped class. Copy/compile helper in private temporary staging workspace if recompilation is needed; never recompile or write inside TinyHttpd checkout.
existing_operational_signing_reuse.signature_validation: Existing helper rejects expired/revoked key, unlocks key using stdin, signs each primary byte sequence using SHA256, and self-verifies generated signature before writing .asc.
existing_operational_signing_reuse.do_not_execute_as_naru: TinyHttpd .publish/publish.py hardcodes its own ROOT/MODULES and validators; do not invoke its central/build commands for NaruServe.

official_api_verified.auth: Bearer base64(username:password) from Portal user token; construct in memory and never log.
official_api_verified.upload_response: Deployment UUID. Persist ID with exact primary-file SHA256 manifest before polling; never upload a second bundle after observation timeout.
official_api_verified.status: POST /api/v1/publisher/status?id=<UUID>; PENDING/VALIDATING/PUBLISHING are live; PUBLISHED succeeds; FAILED requires recorded errors.
official_api_verified.requirements: Sources, javadoc, POM metadata, PGP signatures; md5/sha1 required, sha256/sha512 supported. Signatures do not need checksums and checksums do not need signatures.
official_api_verified.word_limit_note: Paraphrase only; do not copy complete source content.

release_sequence: Finish and integrate every feature with per-REQ evidence; full-suite sufficiency pass, then bilingual technical-writer documentation.
TDD-update version-specific build/POM tests to0.10.0, then version/build/docs/artifact outputs without modifying dependency pins.
Run full JDK17 and actualJava8 suites, API21/class-reference/dependency checks, and supported socket/Servlet regressions on final candidate.
Run -Prelease releaseSbom releaseCheck; fresh vulnerability/license evidence is required, with any pending scan explicitly preserved and never presented as successful scan.
Run checkCentralStaging and staging-only Java/Android consumers including Android minified/R8 release build.
Commit/push reviewed code/docs/evidence; record exact commit/tag and ensure staged artifact bytes correspond to that final commit.
Create private deployment staging from50 primary files, sign/self-verify50, create4 checksums for each, validate clean300-entry archive and dependency pins/POM scopes.
Upload once through official API after final gates; persist UUID+artifact manifest, poll same deployment until terminal.

Download all50 primary artifacts and50 signatures from repo.maven.apache.org, compare hashes/bytes, run MavenCentral-only Java and Android consumers, record proof, close issues only with real evidence.

safe_owned_paths: tools/oracle/ (new only if approved plan owns this path)
available_without_new_deps: Kotlin2.2 test tooling already every Java module

Root tests already depend on NaruServe-gson: Gson JSON fixture parser available through existing API dependency. API-module test runtime does not have Gson; use simple JDK-based corpus or put JSON replay at root instead of adding Gson there.
Jetty existing test dependencies for Servlet integration; do not add another container/framework.
parallel_harness_lane.oracle_dependency_boundary: Reference Express packages already used in prior research may remain isolated external oracle tools at pinned versions; ordinary Gradle replay remains Node-free. Do not introduce Node/npm runtime/build dependency into NaruServe or add Gradle/test libraries.
parallel_harness_lane.schedule: Fixture generator/schema can progress beside matcher implementation after the shared acceptance schema is fixed. Replay tests targeting new public API need the API contract committed first; selective test commands prevent unrelated TDD RED lanes from invalidating others.
parallel_harness_lane.review_contract: Independent tests sufficiency pass up to3 rounds, stopping after first pass; record original failing test evidence, meaningful missing-case fixes, and final pass without weakening tests.
